name: marking-menu
title: Marking Menu
description: A radial menu you open by holding, flicking or right-clicking a surface, with a keyboard path through a Menu button.

props.name: items
props.default: Home, Inbox, Calendar, Files, Search, Compose, Profile, Settings
props.description: Up to eight destinations (id, label, icon), laid out clockwise from the top.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with the item picked, by menu, flick or keyboard.

props.name: children
props.description: The surface the menu opens over. Defaults to a small demo page.
